title: Cloud Production Deployment — Production Acceptance Rubric
source: Derived from Cloud, Server, and Production Deployment — Skill Catalog (Edition 1.0, November 2026), Core Production Acceptance Reference and catalog design notes.
retestProcedure: Fix the failing control in code/configuration; never by hand in production.
Re-run: python3 tools-production-deployment.py assess --config <your-config.json> --format json and confirm the previously failing check ids now report pass.
Re-attach fresh evidence (test output, logs, drill notes) to the change record.
Have a second operator review the delta and sign the closure gate.
Schedule a recurring verification (restore test, failover drill, rotation audit) and record it in the ownership registry.

checks.title: Resource names comply with the cloud naming standard
checks.remediation: Adopt the naming standard (catalog category 1): <service>-<environment>-<region>-<resource>; rename non-compliant resources via IaC.
checks.evidence: Naming lint output or IaC review comment.

checks.title: Required tags present: owner, costCenter, environment, service, dataClassification, backupPolicy
checks.remediation: Apply the tagging standard (catalog category 1): owner, costCenter, environment, service, dataClassification, backupPolicy on every resource.
checks.evidence: Tag policy report from the cloud tag editor/policy engine.

checks.title: Infrastructure changes applied from reviewed code
checks.remediation: Land the change as a reviewed PR; never repair production by undocumented console changes (catalog design note 2).
checks.evidence: Merged PR URL and pipeline run id.

checks.title: Build/deploy artifacts are immutable and pinned
checks.remediation: Pin image digests and module versions; store artifact hashes in the release record; sign artifacts where supported.
checks.evidence: Release manifest with digests and signature verification output.

checks.title: Plans are policy-checked before apply (OPA/conftest/tfsec-class)
checks.remediation: Add policy-as-code gate to the pipeline (catalog category 22): mandatory tags, encryption, no public ingress, pinned modules.
checks.evidence: Policy check report attached to the pipeline run.

checks.title: Remote, encrypted, locked state with backups
checks.remediation: Move state to a locked remote backend (e.g. S3+DynamoDB, GCS, Azure Storage with lease) with encryption and versioning (catalog category 22).
checks.evidence: Backend configuration and lock audit log.

checks.title: Drift detection is scheduled and alerts on divergence
checks.remediation: Schedule periodic plan/refresh; route drift alerts to the owning team (catalog category 22).
checks.evidence: Cron/workflow definition and last drift report.

checks.title: Production change has an approved change record
checks.remediation: Route every production change through the change governance process (catalog category 28): risk, rollback, window, approver.
checks.evidence: Change ticket id with approver and window.

checks.title: Access is least-privilege and reviewed
checks.remediation: Scope roles to required actions/resources; review grants quarterly; remove standing admin (catalog category 3).
checks.evidence: IAM policy review export or access-review sign-off.

checks.title: Credentials are short-lived where possible; deploy credentials isolated
checks.remediation: Use workload identity / OIDC federation / STS instead of static keys; isolate deployment signing credentials; log emergency access (catalog categories 3 and 16).
checks.evidence: OIDC/STS trust policy and credential age report.

checks.title: Endpoints present valid, unexpired TLS certificates
checks.remediation: Automate issuance/renewal (ACM/Let's Encrypt/managed certs); monitor expiry with >= 30 day alerting (catalog category 5).
checks.evidence: Certificate chain inspection (openssl s_client / SSL Labs) dated within 7 days.

checks.title: TLS minimum version is 1.2 or higher
checks.remediation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1; prefer 1.3; verify with a TLS scanner (catalog category 5).
checks.evidence: Scanner report showing negotiated versions.

checks.title: Certificate expires in 30+ days
checks.remediation: Renew now and confirm auto-renewal; alert on expiry at 30/14/7 days (catalog category 5).
checks.evidence: Renewed certificate with dates and monitor screenshot.

checks.title: Data encrypted at rest with managed keys
checks.remediation: Enable encryption at rest for databases, volumes, buckets, and backups with KMS/managed keys; audit key policies (catalog categories 5, 13, 14).
checks.evidence: Encryption configuration export per resource class.

checks.title: Data encrypted in transit everywhere (incl. internal hops)
checks.remediation: Terminate TLS at every hop or use mTLS/service mesh; verify with connection probes (catalog categories 5 and 9).
checks.evidence: mTLS/mesh config or TLS probe results incl. service-to-service.

checks.title: Public endpoints sit behind WAF/abuse protection
checks.remediation: Attach managed WAF rules with rate limiting and bot/abuse protection; log blocked requests (catalog category 20).
checks.evidence: WAF rule group association and block-log sample.

checks.title: Public endpoints enforce rate limits
checks.remediation: Apply per-IP/per-token rate limits at the edge (CDN/WAF/API gateway) with 429 telemetry (catalog categories 15 and 20).
checks.evidence: Rate-limit policy and counter metrics.

checks.title: No unintended public services/ports exposed
checks.remediation: Scan external surface from outside the VPC; close or justify every open port; default-deny security groups (catalog categories 6 and 20).
checks.evidence: External attack-surface scan dated within 14 days; security group diff.

checks.title: Latest vulnerability/image scan passed policy
checks.remediation: Gate releases on scan policy (no criticals; fix or waive highs with expiry); rebuild base images on patch cadence (catalog categories 8 and 21).
checks.evidence: Scanner report for the running artifact digest.

checks.title: Zero open critical findings
checks.remediation: Remediate criticals or obtain a time-boxed, approved exception with compensating controls (catalog category 21).
checks.evidence: Exception register entry or remediation commit/PR.

checks.title: No embedded secrets in code, images, or config
checks.remediation: Move secrets to a vault; add pre-commit and CI secret scanning; purge leaked secrets and rotate (catalog category 16).
checks.evidence: Secret-scan output; vault path list; rotation ticket if leaks found.

checks.title: Secrets rotate on a defined schedule (<= 180 days)
checks.remediation: Enable automatic rotation with staged rollout and revoke-old semantics; verify dependent services (catalog category 16).
checks.evidence: Rotation job status and last successful rotation date.

checks.title: Audit trail enabled (who did what, when) with retention
checks.remediation: Enable cloud audit logs (CloudTrail/Activity Log/Audit Logs) to a locked, retained, searchable store (catalog category 18).
checks.evidence: Audit sink config and sample query results.

checks.title: Backups enabled for all stateful components
checks.remediation: Define backup policies for databases, volumes, queues, and buckets; encrypt backups; set retention (catalog category 23).
checks.evidence: Backup policy listing coverage per store.

checks.title: Restore tested and data validated (not just backup success)
checks.remediation: Run a dated restore into an isolated environment; validate data + app behavior; record timings vs RTO (catalog design note 3 and category 23).
checks.evidence: Restore test log with date, timings, validation checklist.

checks.title: RPO defined and <= 60 minutes
checks.remediation: Pick an RPO from business impact analysis; configure replication/backup frequency to meet it; document it (catalog category 23).
checks.evidence: DR plan stating RPO and the mechanism that meets it.

checks.title: RTO defined and <= 240 minutes
checks.remediation: Pick an RTO from BIA; automate re-provision (pilot light/warm standby/active-active) to meet it; measure by drill (catalog category 23).
checks.evidence: DR plan stating RTO and last drill measurement.

checks.title: Regional/AZ failover drill completed and measured
checks.remediation: Run a scheduled failover drill; record time-to-recover; fix gaps; repeat at least annually (catalog categories 23 and 25).
checks.evidence: Drill report with timings and action items.

checks.title: No single points of failure (>= 2 replicas / multi-AZ)
checks.remediation: Run >= 2 replicas across failure domains; set pod disruption budgets / health checks; test failover (catalog categories 7, 9, 25).
checks.evidence: Replica/AZ spread config and failover test result.

checks.title: Dependency failover tested (DB/cache/queue)
checks.remediation: Fail over the primary database/cache/broker in staging; verify promotion, app reconnection, and data consistency (catalog categories 13 and 25).
checks.evidence: Failover test record with timestamps and outcome.

checks.title: Rollback path rehearsed and documented
checks.remediation: Rehearse the rollback for this release type (blue/green, canary abort, rolling); record time-to-recover; automate where possible (catalog category 12).
checks.evidence: Rollback rehearsal log or automated rollback config + last run.

checks.title: Rollback strategy declared (blue-green | canary | rolling | recreate)
checks.remediation: Declare one strategy explicitly in the deployment config so reviewers and automation can reason about it (catalog category 12).
checks.evidence: Deployment manifest showing the strategy.

checks.title: Load/soak test passed at expected peak
checks.remediation: Load test to >= 1.5x expected peak; verify latency SLOs hold; capture saturation points (catalog categories 25 and 29).
checks.evidence: Load test report with RPS, p95/p99, error rate, saturation.

checks.title: Monitoring covers latency, traffic, errors, saturation
checks.remediation: Instrument the four golden signals per service plus business SLIs; dashboard per service (catalog category 17).
checks.evidence: Dashboard links and metric coverage checklist.

checks.title: SLO/SLI defined with error budget policy
checks.remediation: Define SLI (availability/latency), SLO target, window, and error-budget policy; review monthly (catalog categories 17 and 25).
checks.evidence: SLO document and last error-budget review.

checks.title: Alert delivery to on-call tested end-to-end
checks.remediation: Send a synthetic page; confirm receipt, ack, and escalation chain; separate signal collection from paging (catalog design note 4, category 19).
checks.evidence: Synthetic page test record with timestamps.

checks.title: On-call rota and escalation path defined
checks.remediation: Publish the rota, escalation timeouts, and paging policy; test handovers (catalog category 19).
checks.evidence: Pager rota export and escalation policy.

checks.title: Logs centralized, structured, with retention policy
checks.remediation: Ship structured logs to a central store with retention and access controls; redact PII at ingest (catalog categories 18 and 24).
checks.evidence: Log pipeline config and retention policy.

checks.title: Runbook exists and is linked from alerts
checks.remediation: Write/update the service runbook (symptoms, diagnosis, mitigation, rollback, escalation) and link it from every alert (catalog category 30).
checks.evidence: Runbook URL; alert->runbook link check.

checks.title: Ownership registry updated for this service
checks.remediation: Record owner, team, cost-center, escalation, and DR tier in the ownership registry (catalog category 1).
checks.evidence: Registry entry link or export.

checks.title: Budget alert configured (actual or forecast)
checks.remediation: Set actual and forecast budget alerts at 70/90/100 percent; route to the owning team and FinOps (catalog category 2).
checks.evidence: Budget alert configuration and routing.

checks.title: Monthly budget declared in the deployment config
checks.remediation: Declare the monthly budget; rightsize and schedule non-prod off-hours; review idle resources (catalog category 2).
checks.evidence: Budget figure with owner approval.

checks.title: Data classification declared and known
checks.remediation: Classify the data; apply handling rules (encryption, access, retention, region) per class (catalog category 24).
checks.evidence: Classification record in the data catalog.

checks.title: Retention and deletion policy applied to data and logs
checks.remediation: Define retention per data class and legal hold needs; enforce lifecycle rules; verify deletion (catalog category 24).
checks.evidence: Lifecycle/retention policies and last deletion audit.
